pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.summary: What information GoalCast collects, why, and the choices you have.
pages.html:
This page explains what information GoalCast handles when you use the site. We collect as little as we can.

If you only browse

You can read every prediction without an account, and we do not ask who you are.

  • Preferences stored on your device. Your colour theme, your accumulator slip and whether you switched on match alerts are saved in your own browser so they are still there when you return. They are not sent to us.
  • Hosting records. The company that hosts the site receives standard technical details with each visit, such as your IP address and browser type, as every website's host does. We do not use these to identify you.
  • Visitor counts. We count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics so we know which pages are read. It does not use cookies, does not follow you to other websites and does not build a profile of you; we only see totals, such as how many people opened a page and which country they were in.
  • Team and competition images. Club crests, flags and competition logos are loaded from ESPN's image servers, so ESPN receives the standard technical details of that request, such as your IP address.
  • No advertising trackers. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies, and we do not sell information about visitors.

If you create an account

We store:

  • your email address
  • the name you enter
  • the country you select, used to show prices and ways to pay for where you are
  • the favourite teams you choose, if any
  • your password, in a scrambled (hashed) form that we cannot read

We use these only to sign you in, to let you reset your password, and to unlock member features. We do not send marketing email without asking you first.

Accounts are run for us by Supabase, an account service, which stores this information on our behalf. Members-only content is served from a database hosted by Neon, which receives your sign-in token to confirm your plan but does not store your account details.

If you contact support

If you message us on WhatsApp or Telegram, we see your phone number or username and whatever you write. Those apps have their own privacy policies. We use your message only to answer you.

Sponsors and outside links

Following a sponsor's advert or any other outside link takes you to a website we do not control. The link may tell that website you came from GoalCast. What happens there is covered by that website's own privacy policy.

How long we keep information

Account details are kept while your account exists. Ask us to delete your account and we will remove them.

Your choices

You can ask us to:

  • show you the information we hold about you
  • correct it
  • delete your account and its information

Depending on where you live, the law may give you further rights over your personal information. To make a request, email infogoalcast@gmail.com or use the support links at the bottom of any page.

You can clear the preferences saved on your device at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser settings.

Children

GoalCast is for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

Changes

If the way we handle information changes, we will update this page first. The date at the top shows the latest version.

pages.title: Responsible gambling
pages.summary: Betting should stay a pastime. How to keep it that way, and where to get help.
pages.html:
GoalCast is for adults aged 18 and over. Football predictions are meant to make watching the game more interesting. They are not a way to earn a living, clear a debt or solve a money problem.

What the numbers really mean

  • A probability is not a promise. A pick rated 85% still loses about one time in seven.
  • Accumulators lose far more often than their individual legs. Five 85% picks together land less than half the time.
  • Bookmakers build a margin into every price. Over time, most people who bet lose money. Our own model does not beat the bookmakers, and the model page says so.

Keeping control

  • Set a budget before you start and treat it as the cost of entertainment. When it is gone, stop.
  • Never chase losses. Betting more to win back what you lost is how small losses become large ones.
  • Do not bet with money you need for rent, food, bills or debts, and never with borrowed money.
  • Set a time limit as well as a money limit.
  • Do not bet when upset, stressed or after drinking.
  • Take breaks. Most licensed bookmakers let you set deposit limits, time-outs and self-exclusion. Use them.

Signs that betting is becoming a problem

  • spending more money or time on betting than you intended
  • hiding your betting from family or friends, or lying about it
  • borrowing, selling things or missing bills to fund it
  • feeling anxious, irritable or low when you try to stop
  • betting to escape worries or to recover earlier losses

If any of these sound familiar, talking to someone helps, and the sooner the better.

Where to get help

These services are free and confidential.

  • Gambling Therapy — online support worldwide, in many languages: gamblingtherapy.org
  • Gamblers Anonymous — meetings in many countries: gamblersanonymous.org
  • BeGambleAware (United Kingdom): begambleaware.org
  • GamCare (United Kingdom): gamcare.org.uk
  • National Council on Problem Gambling (United States): call or text 1-800-GAMBLER, or visit ncpgambling.org

If you are in immediate distress or thinking about harming yourself, contact your local emergency services now.

Under 18

It is illegal for anyone under 18 to gamble in most countries. If you share a device with children, consider parental-control software that blocks gambling sites.

pages.title: Terms of use
pages.summary: The rules for using GoalCast, and what the predictions are and are not.
pages.html:
By using GoalCast you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

What GoalCast is

GoalCast publishes football statistics and predictions produced by computer models. It is an information service.

GoalCast is not a bookmaker. We do not accept bets, hold money for you, or place bets on your behalf.

Predictions are not guarantees

Every figure on this site is a probability estimated from past results. Predictions can be and regularly are wrong, including those shown as "safe tips" or with a high confidence rating.

  • Nothing on GoalCast is betting, financial or professional advice.
  • Past accuracy does not guarantee future accuracy.
  • Any decision to bet, and any loss that follows, is your own responsibility.

The results and model pages show how the predictions have performed, including where they fall short.

Who may use the site

You must be at least 18 years old, or the legal age for gambling where you live if that is higher.

Gambling laws differ from country to country. You are responsible for making sure that using this site, and any betting you choose to do elsewhere, is legal where you are.

Accounts

If you create an account, keep your password private and tell us if you think someone else has used it. You are responsible for activity on your account. We may suspend or close accounts that are used to abuse the site.

Premium membership

Premium plans and their prices are listed on the Premium page. Prices are shown in Naira for members in Nigeria and in US dollars elsewhere. You can pay by the methods offered for your country, which may include card, bank transfer and cryptocurrency. Once your payment is confirmed we switch Premium on for your account for the period you paid for. Plans do not renew automatically. Cryptocurrency payments cannot be reversed, so check the amount, address and network before sending.

Premium gives access to additional selections and analysis. It does not guarantee winning bets or profit, and the points under "Predictions are not guarantees" apply to it in full.

If you have a problem with a payment or your access, contact us and we will put it right.

Accuracy of information

Fixtures, results, standings, player statistics and odds come from third-party sources. We work to keep them correct but cannot promise they are complete, current or free of errors. Check important details, such as kick-off times, with an official source.

Sponsors and outside links

Adverts are labelled "Sponsored". Sponsors do not influence the predictions. We are not responsible for the content, offers or practices of other websites we link to, including sponsors. Read their terms before you use them.

Acceptable use

Please do not:

  • copy, resell or republish large parts of the site without permission
  • overload the site or attempt to break its security
  • use the site for anything unlawful

Our content

The GoalCast name, logo, design and written content belong to GoalCast. Team and competition names, crests and logos belong to their owners and are used only to identify matches. GoalCast is not affiliated with or endorsed by any club, league or competition.

Liability

The site is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent the law allows, GoalCast is not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the site or reliance on its content, including betting losses.

Nothing in these terms removes rights that the law of your country gives you and that cannot be waived.

Changes

We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the new terms.

Contact

Questions about these terms: email infogoalcast@gmail.com or use the support links at the bottom of any page.
